response.sql: WITH state_accounts AS (SELECT COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'No State') AS state, COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count FROM Customers c LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY COALESCE(c.state_county_province, 'No State')), total_accounts AS (SELECT SUM(account_count) AS total FROM state_accounts), state_shares AS (SELECT sa.state, sa.account_count, sa.account_count * 100.0 / ta.total AS share FROM state_accounts sa CROSS JOIN total_accounts ta), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM state_shares) SELECT SUM(aa.account_count) AS combined_account_base, AVG(aa.share) AS average_share, AVG(aa.share - av.avg_share) AS average_difference_from_overall_average FROM state_shares aa CROSS JOIN average_share av WHERE aa.share > av.avg_share
